prompt.en: Explain the limitation of comparing connective tissue with reinforced concrete when describing living animal structures.

level1.en: State what the comparison captures correctly, and identify the property of living tissue that concrete does not share.

clue.en: Concrete keeps whatever shape it was poured into. Consider what bone does when the loads placed upon it change.

level2Template.en: Concrete retains the shape in which it was set, whereas connective tissue ___.

accepted: is remodelled in response to the loads placed on it
is living and continually rebuilt by its own cells

text.en: Both consist of a strong matrix reinforced by fibres, which is why the comparison is made at all.
The comparison fails because connective tissue ___, while concrete cannot.
